title: 4x4 mesh, 3-flit P2P burst 0 -> 15: RTL tail latency + cadence

expected.notes: A 3-flit packet over the longest route. 14 payload bytes = 112 bits over a 53-bit usable flit needs 3 flits. RTL tail latency must still obey 7+5d and every flit must eject (1/cycle cadence). Exercises multi-flit packet handling, not just single-flit.
